runner_results.note: The final ci-openui-browser/results.json contains chat-recovery only. Four families are checked independently through 12 original reports and full job-log markers.

record.formal_reports: 33/33 completed and 1056/1056 recorded checks passed; this visual review is an additional, separate evidence layer.

images.observation: Sidebar is visibly covering the list after the final desktop-to-390px viewport change. A persistent toast reads 请先登录，或登录已过期 while the account label still displays sprint-chromium. The screenshot does not record menu class, animation timing or current authenticated session, so it cannot prove a particular sidebar cause or failed authentication.

The same visible sidebar and expired-login toast appear. The six recorded route stages had already completed with current API and DOM IDs before this screenshot; this image is not accepted as settled mobile-list visual evidence.
The same visible sidebar and expired-login toast appear after resizing. The final recorded API requests have status 200; the screenshot itself does not establish when the earlier error was emitted.

Pending-publication recovery panel wraps correctly; retry, reviewed audience renewal and stopping the uncommitted request are visible. No obvious horizontal overflow. The lower form continues below the viewport.

Saved draft attachment and attachment retention choice are visible. The 44px review-and-publish button is fully above the mobile navigation after normal scrolling; raw bounding boxes independently quantify the gap.
The code block, copy/reply actions, composer and toast render within the mobile viewport. The toast is positioned above the composer/navigation. This is not physical keyboard validation.

Desktop board, filters, loaded-range label and saved-position undo toast are visible without obvious clipping. Exact 54-item ordering and reconstructed first-page rank are established by raw DOM/API evidence, not inferred from the image.

read_only_findings: The script calls setViewportSize(390x844) immediately before the final list-cache screenshot; it does not wait for sidebar geometry or visibility to settle. The mobile sidebar stylesheet defines a 240ms transform/visibility transition. This is a possible timing factor, not a proven cause of the original screenshot.

The real api() 401 branch clears the old session and then creates a persistent authentication error toast. auth.submit() accepts a successful new session and routes without clearing that toast; createToastPresenter only checks owner identity for action callbacks, not for persistent display. Independent source review confirms this user-visible stale-message path; a formal runtime reproduction/fix is still pending root coordination.
